name: Slider
description: A value chosen by dragging a thumb along a track. Pattern: https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/slider/ and .../slider-multithumb/

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled value. A number is one thumb and an array is one per entry; leave it out and the widget owns it.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: What it starts at, and what decides how many thumbs there are. Default `min`.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires on every step of a drag and every arrow key, in the shape the value was given in.

props.name: onValueCommit
props.description: Fires once when the interaction ends — the place for a request the live value is too noisy for.

props.name: min
props.description: The bottom of the range. Default `0`.

props.name: max
props.description: The top of the range. Default `100`.

props.name: step
props.description: The grid every value lands on. Default `1`; `0` is a continuous slider.

props.name: largeStep
props.description: What Page Up and Page Down move by. Default ten steps.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Which way the thumbs run. Default `horizontal`, whose arrows follow the reading order.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Not adjustable, by pointer or by key. It is `aria-disabled`, so the thumb keeps its place in the tab order and stays readable.

props.name: label
props.description: What the slider is called. On one thumb it names the thumb; on several it names the group around them.

props.name: labelledBy
props.description: The same, naming an element that already says it.

props.name: thumbLabels
props.description: One name per thumb — "Minimum", "Maximum". A range wants them: `label` names the group, not the thumbs.

props.name: format
props.description: The value as it should be read out, when the number alone is not it: a currency, a date, a rating.

props.name: name
props.description: What the value submits under. One hidden input per thumb, so a range posts two values of that name.

keyboard.action: Every thumb is its own tab stop, so a range is two of them.
One step towards the maximum. In a right-to-left page Left is the increase, and Up never changes: the block axis has no reading order.
`largeStep`, ten steps unless it says otherwise.
The minimum and the maximum themselves, on or off the step grid.

a11y: Each thumb is a `role="slider"` carrying `aria-valuemin`, `aria-valuemax`, `aria-valuenow` and `aria-orientation`; `format` writes `aria-valuetext` for a value a bare number does not read as.
A thumb has to be named, so `label` names the one on a single slider — and on a range it names the `role="group"` around the thumbs, where `thumbLabels` names them one at a time.
`disabled` is `aria-disabled` rather than the attribute: a slider a reader cannot reach is a value they cannot read, and a div takes no `disabled` anyway.
